recovered_class_2.gold_perspective_text: People can improve relationships and make new friends with social media.

newly_accepted_class_1.claim_text: Developing nations should place restrictions on rural-urban migration
newly_accepted_class_1.gold_perspective_text: If developing nations place restrictions on rural-urban migration, the potential for poor rural citizens to improve their quality of life will be lost in these regulations.
newly_accepted_class_1.generated_viewpoint_text: Restricting rural-urban migration impedes the natural flow of labor and innovation, stifling economic dynamism and cultural interaction.
